title: Always-on Base64 XML names remain parseable across encodings
summary: The writer emitted a legal underscore-prefixed Base64 name for the Chinese key. The JDK StAX reader and a fresh Jackson mapper recovered both sides of the adjacent Unicode boundary.

change.description: The always-on name processor puts an underscore before base64url names whose initial encoded character cannot start an XML name and strips that marker during decoding.

notes: Both builds use the later timestamped Jackson 3.3.0 and annotations 2.23 snapshots listed in runtime.json.
